_about: Names we gave to functions of speed.exe 1.3 that the decomp calls sub_XXXXXX or names badly. address -> name, confidence (read = from the disassembly, tested = confirmed in game / by a crash), note. re.py shows these over the decomp's names.

0x634B50.name: GameDevice::GameDevice
0x634B50.note: ctor (port); tables only set for the first device

0x63CD10.name: GameDevice::Create
0x63CD10.note: factory, cdecl (port); registered under 'GameDevice' for IOModule::Initialize

0x63F850.name: GameDevice::InitInputs
0x63F850.note: vtable[3]; creates the 76 input records, port 0 only

0x6349B0.name: GameDevice::PollDevice
0x6349B0.note: vtable[4]; port 0 only; value of an entry = strongest of its 4 slots

0x628940.name: GameDevice::BindingValue
0x628940.note: stdcall (entry, slot), float in st0; only caller PollDevice

0x6285F0.name: GameDevice::AssignBinding
0x6285F0.note: thiscall (event, {type,dev,object}); also resolves duplicates across entries

0x634490.name: GameDevice::OnRebindInput
0x634490.note: turns the pressed input into {type, 0, object}; the device is always 0

0x6283D0.name: GameDevice::JoystickEnumCallback
0x6283D0.note: appends each game controller to the table at 0x91F150 (keyboard 0x91F1D8, mouse 0x91F1E0)

0x628410.name: GameDevice::GlobalInit
0x628410.note: copies the default binding table to 0x91F418, clears the joystick table, enumerates devices; once

0x628C60.name: GameDevice::GetDeviceName
0x628C60.note: stdcall (column 1 keyboard / 3 controller) -> char*; only the Controls header uses it

0x628CB0.name: GameDevice::GetEntrySlots
0x628CB0.note: (entry) -> slots of the live table; also used by the profile save

0x52AF20.name: UIOptionsPCController::SwitchDevice
0x52AF20.note: keyboard <-> controller; reached from PAD_LTRIGGER / PAD_RTRIGGER

0x51D4B0.name: UIOptionsPCController::BindingsChanged
0x51D4B0.note: compares the rows with the screen's copy at +0xE8

0x514960.name: cFEngJoyInput::cFEngJoyInput
0x514960.note: makes ONE ActionQueue (this+0); ports 1-3 stay uninitialised

0x6F22E0.name: LocalPlayer::SetControllerPort
0x6F22E0.note: port at +0x18, feedback +0xC, wheel +0x10 from IOModule.devices[port]

0x5CC240.name: stringhash32
0x5CC240.note: cdecl (const char*), same as bStringHash (h*33+c from 0xFFFFFFFF)
